decision_plan.policy_note: Act-vs-Review Policy: Decisions are auto-applied only when Jev's calibrated probability is ≥ 0.85 (85% confidence) AND the ad set has ≥ 5 days of running data. This threshold balances automation efficiency with risk mitigation. Lower confidence decisions or campaigns with insufficient data are flagged for human review to prevent costly mistakes on immature or uncertain campaigns. Calibrated probabilities from Jev reflect the model's uncertainty and are used as a trust signal for automation safety.
